revision_note: 2026-10-14 (DECISION-011): a director approves graduation after reviewing the submitted field report. This issues the Notice of Ineligibility (household UNDER_INVESTIGATION -> NOTICE_OF_INELIGIBILITY), starts the 15-day appeal window at `notice_date`, and seals one BENEFICIARY_GRADUATED block whose state_delta records decision APPROVED_GRADUATION and the appeal deadline (no new audit action; frozen schema). Grants continue during the window. Refused when the field report does not support graduation or a calamity moratorium (RA 10121) covers the municipality.

request.admin_notes: Field visit confirmed Level 3: private sedan, postpaid plan and household business; utility use above lifeline.

request_rules.decision: required; only APPROVED_GRADUATION is accepted (retention uses POST /tasks/:task_id/retain, DECISION-012)
request_rules.admin_notes: required; 10 to 1000 characters; becomes the stated grounds on the notice
